doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recommending Kenny Kirkland and Darryl Jones for Sting's band
summary: He told Sting to audition Darryl Jones and Kenny Kirkland; Omar Hakim and the singers rounded out the band.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: So there’s Kenny Kirkland, Darryl Jones and….
And Omar Hakim, Janice Pendarvis and Dolette McDonald.
Now were you responsible for bringing Kenny into the band?
Yeah, Kenny and Darryl. I wasn’t responsible for it, no.
I said, “You need to call Darryl Jones to audition and you need to call Kenny Kirkland to audition. And when you do the auditions will be over because they are the best guys.
No. And they came in to audition and he went, “Damn, alright.”
So then he decided that he gonna sing instead of play bass.
No, he didn’t wanna play bass.
